main.description: Record a usage event (storage, egress, llm tokens, gpu hour, api request, mcp call, did mint, yata node-hour, yata edge-hour, yata query CU-ms, yata reasoning run, obj class A/B). Internal endpoint — only `did:web:billing.gftd.ai` host-sdk metering caller is authorized via service auth `lxm`. Idempotent on `vertexId` (content-addressed, ADR-0041).

vertexId.description: Optional client-supplied event ID (content-addressed `at://did:web:billing.gftd.ai/ai.gftd.apps.billing.event/{sha256(orgDid+metric+tsMs+refResource)[:32]}`); auto-generated if omitted.

orgDid.description: ERC725 org DID (`did:erc725:gftd:...`) per ADR-0095. Mapped from API key.

actorDid.description: Optional sub-actor DID (`did:web:*.gftd.ai` or sub-DID path) attributable inside the org for cost split.

tsMs.description: Event ms epoch; defaults to server now().

qty.description: Numeric quantity in metric unit (GB, GB-hour, tokens, hours, count). Float for sub-unit precision.

refResource.description: Optional reference resource ID (yatabase DB name, obj bucket, NSID called) for downstream attribution / per-resource breakdown.

unitCostJpyMicro.description: Server-side cost in JPY-micro (¥ × 1e6). Filled by host-sdk from cost registry; clients MUST NOT supply (overwritten).

listPriceJpyMicro.description: Server-side list price in JPY-micro per metric unit. Filled by host-sdk from price registry.

billedAmountJpyMicro.description: Final billable amount after applied_discount_pct from vertex_billing_org_plan.
